tools.name: list_covered_stocks
tools.description: List the 83 curated AI, space, energy and robotics stocks and ETFs. These get the full QSignals score, including the AI strategic analysis.

tools.name: get_stock_score
tools.description: Get the QSignals score (0-100) and signal for one stock or ETF across short, mid and long horizons, with a one-line reason for each. Curated stocks get the full score; any other US ticker gets a technical-only score (Pro).

tools.name: get_all_scores
tools.description: Get scores for every curated stock on your plan in one call, sorted by the chosen horizon. Use this instead of calling get_stock_score once per stock.

tools.name: get_top_picks
tools.description: Get the highest- or lowest-scored stocks for a horizon. Pro keys only.

tools.name: get_market_regime
tools.description: Get the current market regime for tech stocks (bullish, neutral or bearish), based on QQQ trend and momentum.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Get how past QSignals scores performed: hit rate, average return of the top 10 vs bottom 10 picks, and performance vs QQQ, per horizon.
